patterns.key_values: inset rounded rows with per-row colored tint wash encoding proportion; leading colored folder icon, trailing size + % + disclosure chevron; sentence-case bold section header; iOS-flavored (every row filled, no AppKit flat-row/selection grammar)
custom panel header: leading folder-icon + title/subtitle, center capsule segmented control (Overview/Contents), trailing status pill + share glyph; borderless monochrome symbols
summary card = hero total ('59.5 GB') + two label/value stat pairs (Files/Folders) with glyphs; value outranks label
Quick Look-style transient preview invoked by spacebar in Finder ('Press Space'); whole-window translucent material; monochrome ✕/⊘ panel buttons, no traffic lights
donut/ring chart with system-palette arcs + center total, colour-synced to the list rows (dual encoding of the same data)

signature_moves: Per-row colored tint wash: each 'Largest items' row carries its folder's identity hue as a full-width background wash whose weight tracks rank/proportion — the list doubles as an inline bar/treemap, and the same hue reappears as that folder's donut arc, triple-encoding size (number + row-tint + arc)

Quick Look disguise: the app presents as a native Finder Quick Look panel (spacebar-invoked, translucent, ✕-to-close) rather than a document window — 'Press Space. See everything.' leverages a motion users already have trained
Speed-as-proof status pill: '⚡ 801k items scanned in 2.91 s' surfaces the Rust engine's throughput as a persistent chrome element — performance rendered as a trust signal
defects: Contrast Dilution (risk) — tertiary percentages + '/Users' subtitle at ~40-50% gray over a translucent, wallpaper-tinted ground likely fall below 4.5:1; a floating panel over an arbitrary desktop is the worst case for translucent secondary text

Glass-in-content (low confidence) — list rows and summary card sit on whole-window translucent material with wallpaper showing through; tension with the Liquid Glass golden rule (content opaque), softened because this is a transient Quick Look panel and the composite likely exaggerates translucency

iOS-flavored controls on macOS (native-tell, not universal) — saturated-blue selected segment and inset-grouped tinted rows follow iOS grammar rather than the AppKit segmented/table conventions; excluded from macOS canon per lineage gate

aesthetic.direction: Liquid-Glass consumer-utility with a chromatic data-viz core: warm-translucent light material, capsule/rounded everything, and the full system 12-hue palette used as a through-line across list rows and donut — the opposite pole from the Linear/Vercel dark-utility reflex most disk tools reach for

psychology: Jakob's Law — presenting as Finder Quick Look ('Press Space') borrows an already-trained user expectation, so the tool needs almost no onboarding
Gestalt similarity / pre-attentive color coding — shared identity hues let the eye map a list row to its donut arc without reading, making the two views one glanceable model
Hierarchy via de-emphasis — value outranks label (699,142 over 'Files'; sizes darker than percentages), so the numbers anchor attention
Processing fluency + Doherty threshold — '801k items scanned in 2.91 s' converts sub-perceptual speed into an explicit trust/credibility signal
Von Restorff / signal detection — a single saturated blue (selected segment) against otherwise neutral chrome keeps one clear focal point; no focal collision
Aesthetic-usability effect — glossy translucency + saturated palette raise perceived trustworthiness of a destructive-adjacent tool (finding what to delete) on first contact
notes: SINGLE SURFACE, MARKETING-COVER ONLY: the only design evidence is the app window composited inside cover.png (1280x800) over a warm sunset wallpaper; there are no standalone shot-*.png files. All measurements are (estimated) at unknown downscale — type is read as roles (LargeTitle/Body/Caption), not asserted pt; translucency is likely exaggerated by the marketing wallpaper. No dark mode, no settings/empty/onboarding surfaces, no visible selection or focus state. Lineage is native (SwiftUI) at MED confidence — Catalyst cannot be fully ruled out: the inset-grouped tinted rows + per-row chevrons + saturated-blue segment are iOS-derived tells (recorded as tells + corrections, excluded from macOS canon per the lineage gate); the custom panel chrome, Mac-specific segmented control, share glyph, and Quick Look integration argue native SwiftUI. icon.png (512x512) was NOT digested — this task is Workflow A (UI) only; leave the icon for an icon pass. Reference peer DaisyDisk recurs across the corpus's disk-usage apps (drivemosaic, purge) — but SpacePeek sits in a distinct LIGHT/chromatic/glass register, not the dark-native-utility cluster those occupy.
